Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the pilot scheduled and the GPU capacity aligned: 

1) Success criteria (what Pulsar calls a win):
- Serve 95th-percentile inference latency <= 180ms on the main recommendation endpoint (prompt length ~ 600 tokens).
- End-to-end throughput to support 100 concurrent sessions during business hours without queueing beyond 250ms.
- Model output quality: top-3 reranking MRR >= 0.62 on the provided eval set.
- No data leaves your VPC during the pilot; logs retained for 30 days.

2) Proposal for POC architecture and capacity (initial):
- Reserved: 4x A40-equivalent GPUs in Dedicated pool for baseline sustained load (estimate attached).
- Autoscaling: enable 2x burst nodes (warm) that can be brought up within 60s for traffic spikes.
- KV-cache enabled for hot prefixes; prefix cache should cover the top 20% of session starts.

3) Timeline / owners:
- Week 0 (this week): sign off on success criteria & PO for reserved capacity (owner: Pulsar procurement).
- Week 1: infra provisioning + model onboarding (owner: Dev Patel).
- Week 2: eval run + acceptance gate (owner: Marissa Cole + Pulsar data science).
- Week 3: final tuning and go/no-go decision.

4) Next steps (immediate):
- Liam / Priya: confirm success criteria above (or list updates) by EOD Fri.
- Procurement: provide PO or purchase order window to secure reserved GPUs.
- Dev/Marissa (internal): we'll send a short runbook + GPU estimate (attached).
